title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Discover a range of focused environments across the Rock Island campus, from silent library floors to collaborative science labs and social cafes.

cards.title: Silent Study on the First Floor
cards.subtitle: Quiet Zone in Thomas Tredway Library
cards.notes: Utilize this designated quiet floor for minimal distractions. It is ideal for deep focus and individual research within the main campus library.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet floor in the Thomas Tredway Library for silent, individual study.
cards.evidence_claim: The first floor of the Tredway Library is a designated 'quiet floor' where students do not speak to maintain focus.
cards.source_title: Best study spots on campus | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Open during regular library hours; silent noise policy strictly enforced.

cards.title: Coffee and Collaboration at The Brew
cards.subtitle: Social Study Spot in Gerber Center
cards.notes: Grab a coffee and find a booth or table in this active social space. Outdoor patio seating is available during warmer months for a change of scenery.
cards.short_summary: A social cafe and study area located on the fourth floor of the Gerber Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Brew by the Slough is a campus coffee shop on the fourth floor of the Tredway Library/Gerber Center with tables, booths, and an outdoor patio.
cards.source_title: Best study spots on campus | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Active social environment; open during Gerber Center operating hours.

cards.title: Collaborative Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Reservable Spaces in Tredway Library
cards.notes: Reserve one of eleven rooms for group projects. Second-floor rooms accommodate 4-10 people and include whiteboards; markers are available at the desk.
cards.short_summary: Reservable group study rooms in the Tredway Library equipped with whiteboards and tech.
cards.evidence_claim: The library offers 11 reservable study rooms; 2nd-floor rooms require groups of 4-10 people and include whiteboards.
cards.source_title: Space Availability - Tredway Library - LibCal - Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Reservations required via LibCal; 4-hour daily limit per patron.

cards.title: Science Center Collaboration Hubs
cards.subtitle: Study Areas in Hanson Hall of Science
cards.notes: Find open seating and discussion areas near faculty offices. These spaces are designed for collaborative work and peer-led research discussions.
cards.short_summary: Collaborative study and discussion spaces located within the Hanson Hall of Science.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hanson Hall expansion includes faculty offices with adjoining space for discussion and collaboration.
cards.source_title: Inside the Hanson expansion | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; primarily used by science students but open to all.

cards.title: Central Campus Study in Evald
cards.subtitle: Lobby Seating in Carlsson-Evald Hall
cards.notes: Use the lobby seating for quick study sessions between classes. This central location is convenient for students with courses in the various departments housed here.
cards.short_summary: A convenient lobby study area located in the centrally-located Carlsson-Evald Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Evald lobby is listed as one of the top study spots on campus.
cards.source_title: Best study spots on campus | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Public lobby area; best for casual or short-term study.

cards.title: Wellness-Focused Study Areas
cards.subtitle: Gathering Spaces in Lindberg Center
cards.notes: Study in a modern environment focused on health and human performance. The center features dedicated student and faculty gathering and studying spaces.
cards.short_summary: Modern study and gathering spaces within the Peter J. Lindberg, M.D., Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lindberg Center includes multi-use student and faculty gathering and studying spaces.
cards.source_title: The Peter J. Lindberg, M.D., Center for Health and Human Performance
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; includes a meditation room nearby for quiet breaks.

cards.title: Fine Arts Focused Study
cards.subtitle: New Study Spaces in Bergendoff Hall
cards.notes: Take advantage of newly renovated study and practice rooms. These spaces are ideal for music students or anyone needing a quiet, creative environment.
cards.short_summary: Renovated study and practice rooms located in the Bergendoff Hall of Fine Arts.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bergendoff Hall transformation included the addition of designated practice rooms and study rooms.
cards.source_title: Take a look! Bergendoff Hall transformed | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Open to all students; priority may be given to fine arts majors for certain rooms.

cards.title: Historic Atmosphere in Old Main
cards.subtitle: Classroom Study in the Iconic Landmark
cards.notes: Study in the college's most iconic building. When not in use for classes, the state-of-the-art classrooms provide a quiet and historic setting for work.
cards.short_summary: Quiet study opportunities within the historic and renovated classrooms of Old Main.
cards.evidence_claim: Old Main features state-of-the-art classrooms and is home to multiple academic departments.
cards.access_notes: Available when classes are not in session; building typically closes in the evening.

cards.title: Academic Support at Olin
cards.subtitle: Learning Commons in Olin Center
cards.notes: Visit the Learning Commons for academic coaching or tutoring. The space is designed for both individualized instruction and collaborative group work.
cards.short_summary: An academic support hub in the Olin Center offering tutoring and group study space.
cards.evidence_claim: The Learning Commons main office is located in Olin 320 and offers individualized or group instruction.
cards.access_notes: Open during business hours; tutoring appointments can be scheduled via Starfish.

cards.title: Late Night Study in Erickson
cards.subtitle: Lounge Area in Erickson Hall
cards.notes: Head to the Erickson basement for a change of environment. It features plenty of chairs and tables, making it a reliable spot for collaborative evening sessions.
cards.short_summary: A spacious basement lounge in Erickson Residence Center equipped for student study.
cards.evidence_claim: Erickson has a basement with plenty of chairs and tables set up for students to work.
cards.source_title: Best study spots on campus | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Accessible to residents; non-residents may need to be swiped in.
